sources.snippet: rh-krea-2-outlined-lora Description ... About this model This LoRA is designed to apply a distinct, clean, and bold comic/anime outline style to your characters and scenes. It works exceptionally well for creating vibrant, high-contrast digital art, stickers, and stylized character designs.

sources.snippet: Krea2 is a high-performance image generation model independently developed and open-sourced by the AI creative platform Krea AI. It is not a simple fine-tuning of existing models but a fully trained foundational model with 12 billion parameters built from scratch.
